description: Save (or update) a memory. Memories are markdown files with YAML frontmatter, stored at the resolved memory dir. Use a short kebab-case name; the description is what's shown in the index and used for search ranking.

content.description: Markdown body. For feedback/project, include **Why:** and **How to apply:** lines.

description.description: One-line summary, shown in the index and ranked highly in search

tags.description: Optional tags for cross-cutting categorization. Lowercase, kebab/underscore, max 40 chars each. Queryable in list_memories + search_memories.

type.description: Memory type: user (about the person), feedback (lessons + corrections), project (state/context), reference (external pointers), rule (constraint enforced via companion files — prefer the save_rule tool which validates rule-specific fields)

name: save_memory
